hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFee
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Clanker token pools that enforces separate configurable static LP fees for buying vs. selling the Clanker token, collects a 20% protocol fee on each swap via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns, and activates an optional MEV-protection module during the first 2 minutes after pool creation.
